author: Kairos II
title: Build evolution × liminal hybrid overlay (damped + adjusted fusion)
abstract: Fuse Nova damped and adjusted columns via normalized weighted sum (default 0.5/0.5, min-max), plot with evolution and baselines, and write a summary with φ delta.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json
cmd = [
    'python',
    'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay_hybrid.py',
    '--evolution_csv', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/timeseries_evolution.csv',
    '--nova_csv', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1492/liminal_timeseries.csv',
    '--weights', '0.5,0.5',
    '--norm', 'minmax'
]
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
print(json.dumps({"stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-800:], "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]}))
